calls.title: Should Investors Buy Navitas Semiconductor Stock on the Dip? | NVTS Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Right business at the right time (AI/defense power semis) but overvalued - waiting on the sidelines for a better price or business improvement
calls.base: Revenue collapsed from $90M+ to $36.5M TTM; analysts expect +56% in 2027, +67% in 2028
calls.bull: Backlog converts, 2027-28 growth materializes, margins turn
calls.bear: Negative cash flow worsens (-182% CFO-to-sales); roller-coaster volatility continues
